title: ChatGPT Client Acquisition System
audience: Freelancers who have proven the basic method and want recurring research and pipeline management without APIs.
shortDescription: Turn the method into a scheduled, semi-autonomous system using ChatGPT and Google Workspace.
coreOutcome: Make prospecting a recurring system instead of a recurring chore.
problem: A sound manual workflow still stops when nobody starts the next research or review session.
situation: The method works, but recurring research, follow-up review, and reporting still depend on memory.
commonFailure: Adding schedules without durable state, safeguards, and supervision creates duplicated or inappropriate work.
methodology: Use scheduled ChatGPT tasks with Drive, Sheets, Gmail, explicit state, tests, and review checkpoints.
whoItsFor: Freelancers ready for scheduled no-API operation
whoItsNotFor: Builders who need n8n, custom APIs, or application databases
supervision: Scheduled execution with regular human review
technicalBoundary: Does not center on n8n orchestration, custom API pipelines, application databases, or worker infrastructure.
